recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized female portrait in profile, utilizing minimalist black ink outlines and airbrushed shadows against a stark white background, framed by a black border with technical numbering and featuring circular typographic paths.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp black line work against soft airbrushed gradients
Vibrant red accents in lips and floral motifs against monochromatic skin
Circular text paths echoing the shape of jewelry and floral elements
Technical film-strip border contrasting with organic, fluid illustration
coreInvariants: High-contrast white negative space for skin
Heavy, dark eye makeup with soft blending
Black border with yellow/gold technical numbering
Red as the primary spot color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavily shadowed eye and bright red lips serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the hair from top right, down through the circular text, to the bottom left floral elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of pure white space to define facial structure without internal lines.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson Red (lips, flowers) and Gold (typography, jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high-saturation red pops.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are placed along circular and curved paths rather than straight lines

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the organic flow of the hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying path orientations.
graphicDevices: Film strip border with frame numbers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast fashion illustration of a woman in profile. Use stark white for skin, heavy black ink for hair and eye makeup, and airbrushed burgundy shadows. Add vibrant red lips and abstract red floral patterns. Frame the entire image with a black border containing small yellow technical numbers like a film strip.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply uppercase gold serif text along a circular path in the upper right quadrant and a curved path following the jawline. Ensure the text feels integrated with the hair and jewelry elements.

verificationChecks: Is the skin represented by pure white negative space?
Are the serifs on the typography sharp and high-contrast?
Is the red color limited to specific accent areas like lips and flowers?
Does the black border include technical numbering?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Original technical numbering in the border

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like edges on the main profile
Smooth airbrush gradients in the shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Verify the presence of the film-strip border
Ensure the gold text follows a circular path
Confirm the red accents are vibrant and saturated
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast ink profile + airbrushed shadows + spot red accents + circular serif typography + film-strip border.
